Section 2: Visit Information
Is this your first visit to this CPP?
What were the main reasons for your visit to this CPP today? (Select all that apply)
Other — please specify
Were the medicines or health products you needed available at this CPP today?

Section 3: Client Referral Experience
During today's visit, were you referred to a health facility for further assessment or treatment?
If Yes, what was the main reason for your referral?
Other — please specify
Did the CPP provider explain why you were being referred?
Were you informed which health facility to visit for further care?
How was the referral information provided to you?
Other — please specify
Did the CPP provider explain what you should do after arriving at the referred health facility?
Section 4: Client Experience
Rate each statement: 1 = Strongly disagree, 2 = Disagree, 3 = Neutral, 4 = Agree, 5 = Strongly agree, 6 = I don't know.
The CPP provider listened carefully to my health concerns.
The CPP provider explained my illness or health problem in a way I could understand.
I received clear instructions on how to use my medicines or health products.
I was treated respectfully during my visit.
I am satisfied with the services I received today.
I would use this CPP again if I needed healthcare services.
Section 5: Current Use of Digital Technology During Service Delivery
During today's visit, did the CPP provider use any electronic device (such as a computer, tablet, or smartphone) while providing your service?
If yes, what type of device did you observe the provider using?
To the best of your knowledge, was your information recorded electronically during today's visit?
Based on your observation during today's visit, how would you rate the CPP provider's ability to use an electronic device or digital system while providing your service?
Did the use of an electronic device affect the time you spent receiving services today?

valueCoding.display: Reduced the time spent receiving services
Increased the time spent receiving services
